correctness.rationale: The proof derives the unique intrinsic-volume conditional Dirichlet law, computes the exact two covariance eigenspaces, and reduces their strict difference to a strictly positive beta-function expression using explicit two-step recurrences. Stirling gives the complete leading exponential and polynomial constant with r fixed. Independent direct polynomial integration for six cases, exact rational checks of 54 parameter pairs, and four seeded numerical cases support (but do not replace) the infinite proof. Geometric dimension m>=2 and r>=3, affine normalization and positive beta retention were checked.

value.rationale: Equal parallel-class rank-two matroid base polytopes form a canonical balanced infinite family. Their symmetries leave two Euclidean tangent subspaces, so a strict spectral ordering is a natural geometric question not fixed by vertex/face enumeration. The theorem identifies the exact nonzero gap in every dimension and a sharp exponential isotropization law with explicit rate rho_r and prefactor. It resolves a meaningful structural variance classification, not an arbitrary unmotivated parameter sample or generic formula substitution.
